player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not know the location of the refrigerator and kept trying to put the pillow there from the bedroom or kitchen. I also mismanaged my inventory by trying to carry three items (plate, book, pillow) at once, which caused me to drop items or be unable to move them. The correct strategy is: 1) First, go to the kitchen, open the cupboard, and take both the plate and the book. 2) Go to the bedroom, open the wardrobe, and take the pillow. 3) Immediately put the pillow back into the wardrobe (or discard it if the game allows, but the goal is to put it in the fridge, so I must find the fridge first). 4) Crucially, I need to locate the refrigerator. Since I cannot see it in the bedroom or kitchen, I should check the pantry or the living room. 5) Once I find the refrigerator, I must ensure I only carry the pillow (putting the plate and book back in the cupboard/wardrobe first) to avoid inventory limits. 6) Finally, put the pillow in the refrigerator, then return the plate to the cupboard and the book to the wardrobe.
